claims.statement: The C3-F4 bounded controls are arithmetically reproducible, but neither resolve the lower-region complete aggregate nor prove an n=2p+3 pointwise extension; the positive example is ineligible and the seeded sample is non-exhaustive.
claims.scope: Review of the sole C3-F4 claim: exact marked-star and order-11 controls, analytic p=3,4 exclusions at n=2p+3, and seeded Prüfer samples for p=6..10 only. No universal conclusion and no audit award for the imported first-shell proof.
claims.reason: retained_narrowed: independent scratch replay reproduces the route's finite values, favorable set, separate same-support terms and aggregate. The full sum +147 violates x+2<=p (7>4); the marked-star example only falsifies omission of tau>=3 in a graph lemma; the random sample is not exhaustive. The route itself leaves the primary claim open and does not prove the n=2p+3 extension.

limitations: The replay is bounded and does not provide a generation-complete census.
